pool.text: Oslo was founded as a city at the end of the Viking Age.
Hovedøya Abbey was built during the medieval period in the region.
A destructive fire occurred leading to the construction of a new city.
Anatomigården, a historic timber framing house, was built on Christiania Torv.
The last Black Death outbreak occurred in Oslo during this year.
The Royal Frederick University, now known as the University of Oslo, was founded.
City Hall construction began in the former slum area of Vika.
PST security agency was established as a non-secret agency in Norway.
Norway was invaded by Germany and the city remained under occupation.
Allied bombers missed their target and hit a tram causing civilian casualties.
Oslo began sending an annual Christmas tree expression of gratitude to Britain.
Oslo merged with the surrounding Aker municipality to create a much larger area.
The Oslo Philharmonic has been based at the Oslo Concert Hall.
Aker Brygge was constructed on the former shipyard site of Akers Mekaniske Verksted.
The combined municipality and county introduced a parliamentary system of government.
Oslo hosted the Eurovision Song Contest for the first time.
Oslo Airport redevelopment at Gardermoen opened as a massive construction project.
Archaeological findings called for the celebration of Oslo's millennium.
The Oslo International Church Music Festival has been held annually.
Oslo received the prestigious European Sustainable City Award for its efforts.
